mailIntakeEntry.title: Mail intake entry
mailIntakeEntry.description: One message the intake mailbox processed, with its original, its authentication results, the filter that decided and what became of it.

mailMessageId.title: Message id
mailMessageId.description: The RFC 5322 Message-ID of the processed message

accountId.title: Mail account
accountId.description: The Nextcloud Mail account the message arrived on

mailbox.title: Folder
mailbox.description: The folder the message was read from

uid.title: Message uid
uid.description: The message uid inside that folder

sender.title: Sender
sender.description: The sender address, which is what a handler searches the log by

recipient.title: Recipient
recipient.description: The address the message was addressed to

sentAt.title: Sent at
sentAt.description: When the sender says they sent it

decidingFilter.title: Deciding filter
decidingFilter.description: The named filter that decided, empty when the pipeline reached its accept default

filterReason.title: Filter reason
filterReason.description: Why the filter decided as it did, in a sentence a handler can read

spfResult.title: SPF result
spfResult.description: SPF as the receiving server reported it. Unavailable means no check was made and never means pass

dkimResult.title: DKIM result
dkimResult.description: DKIM as Nextcloud Mail verified it

dmarcResult.title: DMARC result
dmarcResult.description: DMARC as the receiving server reported it. Unavailable means no check was made and never means pass

threadingResult.title: Threading result
threadingResult.description: Whether a referenced message id is one this account really holds. Fail means the reply claim is forged

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: What became of the message. Every processed message has one and there is no seventh value meaning dropped

case.title: Case
case.description: The case the message became or was linked to, empty when it became none

original.title: Original
original.description: The raw source of the message, which is the answer to 'ik heb wel gemaild'

originalTruncated.title: Original truncated
originalTruncated.description: Whether the stored original was cut at the size cap

forwardedTo.title: Forwarded to
forwardedTo.description: The address a bounce sent the message on to, under Awb 2:3

forwardedBy.title: Forwarded by
forwardedBy.description: The user id of whoever bounced it

movedTo.title: Moved to
movedTo.description: The folder a move filed the message in

movedBy.title: Moved by
movedBy.description: The user id of whoever moved it

junkRule.title: Junk rule
junkRule.description: The rule that classified the message as junk, so an administrator can read why

releasedBy.title: Released by
releasedBy.description: The user id of whoever released a quarantined message

intakePolicy.title: Intake policy
intakePolicy.description: What a failing sender-authentication verdict means for this kind of case. A melding from an unauthenticated sender is normal. A bezwaar from one is a forgery risk. Quarantine is the default because it neither drops a message nor files a forged one.
